{{Top|leg}}
'''''Treatise on Starfighter Tactics''''' was a book written by [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]. It was issued by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] through the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] system, with one of its readers including then-Imperial Academy student [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], which he had employed with the ''Millennium Falcon'' despite the book being intended for starfighter pilots. It was employed thoroughly by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
